evidenceType: manual adjudication of axe color-contrast incomplete results
manualRule: Each color-contrast incomplete was mapped to the exact-main CSS foreground and opaque local background. A conservative 4.5:1 threshold was applied to every occurrence. This resolves only these axe incompletes and is not a complete WCAG conformance claim.
